job.name: vk3_post_compare
job.style: A finished, premium, modern graphic for the VK social-network community of «ИИАВАТАР» — a service that turns any text into a video with an AI presenter (digital avatar), for business: ads, staff training, Reels/short clips, online lessons, videos in 30+ languages. Brand style: deep graphite #111311 background, vivid orange #F3531B accent with subtle orange glow, white text, bold modern condensed grotesque headlines, clean and minimal, high contrast, 2026 tech-product aesthetic. Any people are photorealistic, diverse, friendly professionals (NOT celebrities). Perfectly spelled Russian text is REQUIRED and is the ONLY text: headline «СЪЁМКА или ИИ-ВЕДУЩИЙ» and two column titles «Студия» and «ИИАВАТАР» with short lines under them: «2–3 недели» / «1 день», «пересъёмка» / «правка текста». No other words, no phone numbers, no links, no watermarks, no real app UI or logos.
job.style_qa: графика в графитово-оранжевом стиле ИИАВАТАР, надписи без ошибок: headline «СЪЁМКА или ИИ-ВЕДУЩИЙ» and two column titles «Студия» and «ИИАВАТАР» with short lines under them: «2–3 недели» / «1 день», «пересъёмка» / «правка текста»; лишнего текста, ссылок и телефонов нет
job.prompt: Split comparison: left half muted grey with a film camera, lights and a clapperboard (old way), right half glowing orange-accented with a friendly AI presenter on a screen (new way); a thin divider; headline across the top. Square post image, all text large and readable on a phone, safe margins 8% on every side.
